jobs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: reusable transparent top-down VTT wreck token, MEDIUM size.
Input image 1 is STYLE ONLY: match the grounded painterly post-apocalyptic token rendering, clear surface shading and muted materials of this approved car wreck. Do NOT copy any car shape, bodywork or identifiable unit.

Primary subject: a compact irregular low mound of fused, melted, charred ROBOTICS PARTS after a machine has self-destructed. It must be anonymous remains usable for many unrelated robots and drones. A few crumpled charcoal-steel plates have sagged into bubbled dull-silver molten metal and soot-black fused lumps, trapping broken servo housings, short bent actuator rods, flattened motor windings and tangled partly melted copper wiring. The material is cooled solid, with heat discoloration and a few small oxidized brown edges. Charcoal, ash grey, dull steel, restrained burnt copper. Broad readable masses with a few sharp metal highlights, painterly realism consistent with the reference rather than a glossy 3D render.
The heap came from a human-sized machine and has an approximately 1.3 metre spread. Show a modest quantity of parts, several fist-sized servo remnants and bent thin sheet metal. No intact silhouette, torso, robot head, face, complete limbs, complete wheels, tank tracks, rotor, cannon, vehicle frame or identifiable franchise machine. It is a fused mound, not an assembly of separate functioning objects, and not scrap neatly sorted for sale.

Strict orthographic view directly overhead, no horizon or visible vertical side faces. One single irregular roughly round mound centered in a SQUARE canvas. Its longest dimension fills about 90% of the canvas, with clear transparent margins on all four sides. Soft neutral upper-left light only on the parts. Preserve deep readable crevices while letting metal edges distinguish the pile from the map.
Real transparent alpha background, including holes through the heap. Absolutely no ground, floor, circular base, ring, scenery, cast shadow outside the parts, ash carpet, crater, loose debris field, smoke, steam, flames, glowing embers, magical light, lettering, symbols, labels, scale ruler, people, gore or watermark.

referenceRoles.role: style only; never identity or geometry
